initialize.instructions: Before the first substantive action, call aki__akidevrule_context once; pass an absolute workingPath when known. Do not discover or read bootstrap files individually. A returned receipt is the only success signal. Every tool that acts (not read-only) takes receipt=<the sha256:… receipt this returns> and refuses without it, with an unknown one, or once the rules change; then call this again and pass the new receipt. Then follow /akirule: the SKILL.md routing table is already included in this output (and in every session) — do not re-read SKILL.md; from its routes, Read only the RULE/METHOD files the task needs, since those are not preloaded. Open your first reply with `[RULES] agent (core) + <topics> (router)` naming the route files you actually Read; a receipt without (router), or the sha256 line copied, is a violation. Attempt an operation before calling it impossible, never claim a missing capability, and on failure report the exact command, absolute path, exit status and stderr; state the action and its impact before a destructive or external step. Session file (ss): the `ss:` line of the aki__akidevrule_context result is this chat's file, an absolute path made for you; never build one yourself. Create it with the first act that changes something (a file edit, a commit, a writing command) or when the owner asks for it; skip it for Q&A and lookups. Keep one per chat: pass it back as ss=<path> on every later aki__akidevrule_context call and beside receipt on every acting call. Use the shape in docs/feat/session-file.md — `status`/`repo`/`chat`/`started`/`parent`/`successor`/`room`/`plan`/`transcript` frontmatter, then `## Now`/`## Asked`/`## Next`/`## Decisions`/`## Open`/`## Files`/`## Log` — not whole pasted messages; the write-time line reports what the file still lacks. In every turn that acted, rewrite `## Now`, append one `## Log` line, and end your reply with `ss: <absolute path> · <what changed>`; no write, no line. Set `status` when the chat ends or hands off. One writer per chat: a handoff successor mints its OWN ss with `parent: <old ss>`, and the old chat sets its own `status: handed-off` and `successor: <new ss>` — never write another chat's ss. In a council session, the seat file the opener names (`<room>/<seat>.md`) is this chat's ss, and posts in the room thread carry no `ss:` line. A result line `ss: <path> · last written N min ago` or `· not created yet` means the file is behind this chat's work. `folder missing`: create the folder first. A page title starting with a handle like P2·W1 · means you are inside an AIObox window: call aki__aiobox op=state first.

workingPath.description: Absolute local file or directory path for applicable project context

ss.description: The ss path this tool returned earlier in this chat, kept instead of a new one

label.description: A short name for this chat, used in a new ss file name

shell.name: aki__run_cmd
shell.title: Run Command
shell.description: Run one allowlisted shell command. Default set is inspection-first (ls, cat, grep, head, tail, stat, git status/log/diff/show, …); the owner extends it in the panel. Output: ANSI removed, repeats counted; past ~20k chars only start and end are shown, the full text saved to a file the output names. stderr follows under [stderr]; a failure adds the exit code. Commands stop after 10s; a dev server or watch fits aki__task_start. Dedicated tools are cheaper: find_path/search_content, read_text_file, git (find is not allowlisted: its flags escape read-only). cwd: absolute path under an allowed root, or relative to the first root. One command per call, no chaining/redirection.

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

search.name: aki__find_path
search.title: Find Path
search.description: Find files AND directories anywhere under the configured roots in one call — use this first when locating a project, repo, or file by name, instead of walking directories one level at a time. query is a case-insensitive substring by default ("mcp" finds aki-mcp-sv), or a glob when it contains * or ? ("*.config.js", "src/**/*.ts"). Globs without a slash match the basename. Skips node_modules/.git/build output automatically; the result names the skipped directories, the depth limit and unreadable directories it hit on line 1 as omitted from search. Directories come back with a trailing slash.

path.description: subdirectory to search under, absolute or relative to the root

search.name: aki__search_content
search.title: Search Content
search.description: Search file contents recursively under the configured roots and return file:line:text. Case-insensitive extended regex (grep -iE): put every alias in one query with | — "funnel|ingress|thay.*funnel" hits EN+VI+synonym in one call, no need for separate calls per term. Use after find_path when you need where a string actually appears. glob narrows by filename (e.g. "*.json"). Skips binaries and build/vendor directories (a no-match result lists them). A timed-out or over-capture search says incomplete on line 1.

filesystem.name: aki__read_text_file
filesystem.title: Read Text File
filesystem.description: Read the complete contents of a text file. Use "tail"/"head" to read only the last/first N lines of a large file instead of the whole thing. Only works under the configured roots.

tail.description: If provided, returns only the last N lines

head.description: If provided, returns only the first N lines

filesystem.name: aki__write_file
filesystem.title: Write File
filesystem.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing one. Use with caution — overwrites without warning. Only works under the configured roots.

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

filesystem.name: aki__edit_file
filesystem.title: Edit File
filesystem.description: Make targeted edits to a text file: each edit replaces an exact (or whitespace-tolerant) text match with new text. Returns a git-style diff of what changed. Set dryRun to preview without writing.

oldText.description: Text to search for — must match

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

filesystem.name: aki__create_directory
filesystem.title: Create Directory
filesystem.description: Create a directory (and any missing parents). Succeeds silently if it already exists.

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

filesystem.name: aki__move_file
filesystem.title: Move File
filesystem.description: Move or rename a file/directory. Fails if the destination already exists. Both source and destination must be under the configured roots — this is the only sanctioned move/rename path (the shell tool's allowlist deliberately excludes mv).

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

filesystem.name: aki__get_file_info
filesystem.title: Get File Info
filesystem.description: Get size, timestamps, permissions, and type for a file or directory, without reading its content.

filesystem.name: aki__list_allowed_directories
filesystem.title: List Allowed Directories
filesystem.description: List the directories this server can currently read/write. Subdirectories within them are also accessible.

postman.name: aki__postman_status
postman.title: Postman Control Status
postman.description: Report whether the Postman control daemon is running and its live CDP ownership state. Does not launch Postman or open a connection.

postman.name: aki__postman_eval
postman.title: Postman: evaluate JS in the app
postman.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression inside the running Postman desktop renderer over CDP and return the serialized result. Auto-discovers Postman's remote-debugging endpoint (launch Postman from the Aki panel first) and its main renderer target. Use it to inspect or drive Postman's own UI.

expression.description: JS evaluated in the Postman renderer; the last expression is returned

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

postman.name: aki__postman_rename_conversation
postman.title: Postman: rename current chat
postman.description: Rename the currently open Agent Mode conversation by driving Postman's own inline edit (double-click → type → Enter) so the change persists in app state.

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

postman.name: aki__postman_panel_fullwidth
postman.title: Postman: toggle right panel full width
postman.description: Override the width of Postman's right context panel (#global-contextbar-overlay-container) to fill the window via an injected style tag that survives re-renders. Pass enable=false to restore.

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

cdp.name: aki__devtools_targets
cdp.title: DevTools: list targets
cdp.description: List the CDP page targets on a Chromium/Electron remote-debugging endpoint (Chrome, Postman, VS Code, …). Provide port or omit to use active Chrome session. A window not launched by aki__chrome_launch has no active session: find its port with aki__port_status first, then pass port.

cdp.name: aki__devtools_eval
cdp.title: DevTools: evaluate JS
cdp.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression inside a page/renderer over CDP and return the serialized result (throws surface the page-side error). Optionally pick the target by a url/title substring (filter) or an exact targetId; default = first page. For Postman, aki__postman_eval finds its endpoint and main renderer itself. A window not launched by aki__chrome_launch has no active session: find its port with aki__port_status first, then pass port.

expression.description: JS evaluated in the page; the last expression is returned (returnByValue)

filter.description: substring matched against "<url> <title>" to choose the target

awaitPromise.description: await a returned Promise before serializing (default true)

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

cdp.name: aki__devtools_screenshot
cdp.title: DevTools: capture screenshot
cdp.description: Capture a screenshot of a Chromium/Electron target page over CDP. Returns image directly in MCP response. A window not launched by aki__chrome_launch has no active session: find its port with aki__port_status first, then pass port.

filter.description: substring matched against "<url> <title>" to choose target

aiobox.name: aki__aiobox
aiobox.title: AIObox: read windows
aiobox.description: AIObox windows. Call op=state first: it returns the guide and every op with its args. window = handle, chatId or targetId; expect = text the target chat's url or title must contain; args as the guide says. Each op's help in op=state overrides the guide. Reads only; to act use aki__aiobox_write.

expect.description: text the target chat's url or title must contain; refused if the window shows another

wait.description: seconds this call may take (default and most 50)

args.description: op arguments, as the guide says

aiobox.name: aki__aiobox_write
aiobox.title: AIObox: act in windows
aiobox.description: AIObox windows, acting. Same envelope as aki__aiobox plus receipt (the sha256:... from aki__akidevrule_context); call its op=state first: op, window, expect, args as the guide says. Each op's help in op=state overrides the guide. from = your own window, so AIObox can refuse acting on yourself. One call takes at most 50 s.

expect.description: text the target chat's url or title must contain; refused if the window shows another

wait.description: seconds this call may take (default and most 50)

args.description: op arguments, as the guide says

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

chrome.name: aki__chrome_profiles
chrome.title: Chromium: list installed browsers and profiles
chrome.description: List installed Chromium browsers (Chrome, Brave, Edge) and their profiles (name, email, folder ID) from Local State, plus shared clone ids for chrome_launch.

chrome.name: aki__chrome_launch
chrome.title: Chromium: open shared profile on a CDP port
chrome.description: Opens a shared profile clone (logins kept). If another process runs it, attaches to its CDP port (owned false) and opens url as a new tab; else launches stealth Chrome on --remote-debugging-port=0 (owned true). Never clones.

profile.description: Profile 14 or shared id chrome-profile-14 (default Default)

url.description: URL to open (new tab on attach)

headless.description: only for a new launch (default false)

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

chrome.name: aki__chrome_tabs
chrome.title: Chromium: manage tabs (list, open, close, activate)
chrome.description: Manage page tabs on the active Chrome session or target port. Supports listing open tabs, opening new URL, closing, and activating a tab.

url.description: URL to open when action is open

targetId.description: target ID to close or activate

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

chrome.name: aki__chrome_interact
chrome.title: Chromium: interact with DOM element (click or type)
chrome.description: Interacts with a web page: "click" scrolls the element into center view before clicking; "type" dispatches synthetic input and change events so React/Vue/SPA forms accept the value.

selector.description: CSS selector of the target element

text.description: text to type (required for type action)

clear.description: clear existing value before typing (default false)

enter.description: dispatch Enter key after typing (default false)

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

chrome.name: aki__chrome_stop
chrome.title: Chromium: stop active or specified Chrome session
chrome.description: Ends the active session: kills a Chrome this server launched (owned true), only forgets an attached one (owner keeps running). An explicit pid is always killed.

pid.description: PID to kill (default: active session if owned)

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

fetch.name: aki__local_fetch
fetch.title: Localhost & Intranet HTTP Fetcher
fetch.description: Make HTTP/HTTPS requests to localhost, local dev servers, or internal LAN services with SSRF protection (blocks cloud metadata/link-local addresses; enforces 512KB cap and max 15s timeout).

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

system.name: aki__notify_user
system.title: OS Notification & Sound Alert
system.description: Display a native OS desktop notification and sound alert (macOS notification banner with Glass chime, Windows Toast, Linux notify-send) to alert the user when a long task completes.

message.description: notification message to show the user

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

system.name: aki__clipboard_read
system.title: Read System Clipboard
system.description: Read the current text content from the operating system clipboard (pbpaste / Get-Clipboard / xclip).

system.name: aki__clipboard_write
system.title: Write to System Clipboard
system.description: Copy text into the operating system clipboard so the user can immediately paste it (pbcopy / Set-Clipboard / xclip).

text.description: text to copy into the clipboard

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

task.name: aki__task_start
task.title: Start Background Task
task.description: Start an allowlist-approved shell command in the background (detached process). Logs are streamed directly to disk with zero-RAM overhead. Returns taskId and pid for tracking with aki__task_manage.

command.description: The shell command to run in background (e.g. "npm test", "git status")

taskId.description: Optional unique identifier for the task (letters, numbers, _, -)

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

task.name: aki__task_manage
task.title: Manage Background Tasks
task.description: Manage background tasks started with aki__task_start: inspect status/liveness, tail logs without loading full files into memory, stop process trees cleanly across platforms, list tasks, or delete finished records.

action.description: Action: status, tail_logs, stop, list, delete

taskId.description: Task ID (required for status, tail_logs, stop, delete)

maxBytes.description: Max bytes to tail from log file (default: 10240)

lines.description: Max lines from end of log to return

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

port.name: aki__port_status
port.title: Check listening ports and dev servers
port.description: Inspect active TCP listening ports and processes (e.g. dev servers on port 3000, 5173, 8080). Provide `port` to check a specific port, or omit to list all listening ports.

port.name: aki__kill_port
port.title: Kill process listening on a port
port.description: Terminate the process(es) listening on a specific TCP port (e.g. freeing port 3000 when EADDRINUSE). Will refuse to kill the Aki MCP server itself.

force.description: Send SIGKILL instead of SIGTERM (default false)

receipt.description: required: the sha256:… receipt from aki__akidevrule_context

git.name: aki__git
git.title: Read-only git
git.description: Read-only git with compact output, cheaper in tokens than run_cmd. op=status: branch, upstream, staged/unstaged/untracked as JSON. op=diff: working-tree diff (staged=true for the index, file= to narrow); a big diff shows whole files first and names the omitted ones so you can ask for them with file=. op=log: last commits as {commits:[{hash,author,date,subject}],more} JSON (limit, max 50); subject line only, the full message is `git log` through run_cmd; more=true means older commits exist. op=tags: local tags newest first, or the remote's tags when remote=<configured remote name>. Warnings follow under [stderr]. Anything that writes (commit, push, branch, tag creation) goes through run_cmd.

remote.description: tags: configured remote name, to list its tags instead of local ones

sqlite.name: aki__sqlite_schema
sqlite.title: Inspect SQLite database schema
sqlite.description: Read schema of a local SQLite database (.sqlite, .db, .sqlite3). Returns all tables, views, columns, and indexes.

dbPath.description: Absolute or relative path to SQLite database file within allowed roots

sqlite.name: aki__sqlite_query
sqlite.title: Execute read-only SQL query on SQLite database
sqlite.description: Execute a read-only SQL query (SELECT, PRAGMA, EXPLAIN, WITH) on a local SQLite database. Writes and DDL are strictly rejected. Output capped at 100 rows.

dbPath.description: Path to SQLite database file within allowed roots
